summary: Lotus Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing 'Focus 2030,' a strategic business plan centered on brand reinforcement, multi-powertrain approach (ICE, PHEV, BEV), and financial discipline. The filing describes a new hybrid-V8 supercar (Type 135) expected in 2028 and early orders for the Eletre X in China. No specific terms, deal structure, or closing mechanics are provided. This is a routine business update without a special-situation transaction. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or similar event. The announcement is ordinary strategic planning, not a triggering event.
